prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt a mixed Arabic/English iPad budget screen to right-to-left layout. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. All arrows and media-play icons are mechanically flipped, currency strings reorder digits, text is right-aligned even for email addresses and item hierarchy still assumes left-to-right navigation. Long Arabic labels clip.

criteria.task_completion: Patch reading/navigation direction and semantic alignment, protect bidirectional numbers/identifiers and directional-versus-universal symbols, with concrete mirrored and unmirrored examples.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the right-to-left guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch reading/navigation direction and semantic alignment, protect bidirectional numbers/identifiers and directional-versus-universal symbols, with concrete mirrored and unmirrored examples.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch reading/navigation direction and semantic alignment, protect bidirectional numbers/identifiers and directional-versus-universal symbols, with concrete mirrored and unmirrored examples.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
